name: OG Default Image
description: Sets a default Open Graph image for Metatag.
project_description:
The OG Default Image module allows you to upload a default Open Graph (OG) image for your Drupal site. It integrates with the Metatag module, enabling the use of a token to dynamically insert the uploaded image URL into your Open Graph meta tags.

 How to Use 
 Install the module.

Go to /admin/config/search/metatag, there you will see a new tab "Default OG Image".

On the Default OG Image configuration page, upload your image.

(Recommended dimensions are 1200x630px.)

Use the token [og_default_image:og_default_image] in the Open Graph image URL field of the Metatag settings.

 Additional Requirements 
 Metatag module
